entities.name: Spikefields
entities.description: Perilous crystalline region of northern Akoum on Zendikar, part of the Teeth of Akoum.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Invaders whose passage uncovered ruins in the Spikefields.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire whose ruined fortresses were unearthed.

entities.name: Stone Havens
entities.description: Shelters made from the ruins and bound to hedrons.

entities.name: Ghostwatch
entities.description: Haven home to Mul Daya elves and kor clerics who invoke ghost guardians.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People drawn to Akoum; stoneforge mystics carry on Nahiri's lithomancy.

events.summary: As the Eldrazi pass, volcanic rock crumbles, revealing buried fortresses of the Makindi Empire.
events.quote: ancient ruins long buried beneath the Spikefields have been revealed

events.summary: Stoneforge mystics turn the ruins into Stone Havens bound to hedrons to ward off the Eldrazi.
events.quote: These mystics have turned the exposed ruins into shelters known as Stone Havens

events.summary: At Ghostwatch, Mul Daya elves and kor clerics invoke kor revenants and elf ghosts as guardians.
events.quote: Together, they have invoked kor revenants and elf ghosts to guard the haven

relations.quote: a perilous region of northern Akoum on the plane of Zendikar
One notable haven, Ghostwatch , is home to a remnant of Mul Daya elves
